name: sim_cvc5_arena_composition_constraint
description: Arena composition in game semantics: move count constraint via cvc5 SMT, Poincaré series via sympy

pytorch.reason: pytorch not needed; pure symbolic/algebraic computation via cvc5 and sympy

pyg.reason: PyG message passing not needed; arena composition handled via SMT solver

z3.reason: z3 not needed; cvc5 handles all SMT constraint proofs in this sim

cvc5.reason: cvc5 SMT solver: load_bearing proof of arena composition constraints

sympy.reason: sympy: supportive symbolic algebra for Poincaré series formulas

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed; arena composition constraints only

geomstats.reason: geomstats not needed; no differential geometry in this sim

e3nn.reason: e3nn not needed; no SO(3) equivariance required

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx not needed; no graph structure in this sim

xgi.reason: xgi not needed; pairwise interactions only

toponetx.reason: toponetx not needed; standard algebraic ops sufficient

gudhi.reason: gudhi not needed; no persistent homology in this sim

test_simple_composition_lower_bound.interpretation: Composition satisfies move count lower bound

test_larger_composition.interpretation: Larger composition at lower bound constraint

test_poincare_series.formula: P(A⊗B, t) = P(A, t) * P(B, t)

test_insufficient_move_count.interpretation: Composition with insufficient moves violates constraint (UNSAT)

test_severe_move_deficit.interpretation: Large deficit in move count violates constraint (UNSAT)

test_poincare_additive_vs_multiplicative.interpretation: Additive composition formula differs from multiplicative (constraint proof)

test_single_move_composition.interpretation: Single-move arenas compose to at least 2 moves

test_trivial_arena_composition.interpretation: Trivial arena (0 moves) leaves composition unchanged
